title: Rubber Duck plugin store metadata
description: Optional marketing metadata (store.json) for a plugin. Lives next to plugin.json and is merged into index.json by the build tooling. Screenshot assets are committed under the plugin folder and are NOT shipped inside the .duckplug package.

longDescription.description: Extended store description in Markdown, shown on the plugin detail view.

screenshots.description: Screenshot image paths relative to the plugin folder (e.g. screenshots/1.png). Resolved to raw repo URLs in the generated index.
